production.note: US model years. Consumer Guide (Tom Appel) covers the '1997-01 Honda Prelude' ('Only base and SH editions went on sale' for 1997) and says the Prelude 'would not continue for 2002'. The Type SH was offered for the whole run.

body.note: Two-door coupe; the only body style of the 5th-generation Prelude.

displacementL.note: 2,157 cc ('132 cid/2157 cc'). 2,157 cc rounds to 2.2 L; The Auto Channel's 1997 panel prints the same engine as '2.15 liters / 132 cu. in.' (russ-1997-prelude-sh).

aspiration.note: Inferred: a DOHC VTEC four with no forced induction mentioned by any opened source.

drivetrain.note: Inferred: front-wheel drive; the Type SH's Active Torque Transfer System (ATTS, 'The top-of-the-line Prelude Type SH introduces the Active Torque Transfer System') apportions torque between the front wheels.

transmission.note: 'only manual shift went into the SH model' (Consumer Guide). The base Prelude also offered a 4-speed SportShift automatic; the Type SH was 5-speed manual only.

powerHp.note: PROVISIONAL source class for power (no Honda page; not a major-magazine panel). 1999-2001 rating. Quote (The Auto Channel 1999 Type SH spec panel, John Heilig): "200 hp @ 7000 rpm/156 lb-ft @ 5250 rpm". Also Tom Hagin's 2001 Type SH panel: "200 @ 7000 RPM" (hagin-2001-prelude-sh), and Collectible Automobile (Don Sikora II): "in 1999 the engine picked up five horsepower for an even 200" (ca-prelude-type-sh). The 1997-98 cars were rated 195 hp ('Horsepower 195 @ 7000', russ-1997-prelude-sh); 200 hp covered 1999-2001, more than half of the model years, so the record uses it. No Honda page could be opened; three named-author publication panels agree.

weightLb.note: Type SH, 5-speed manual. Quote (Collectible Automobile, Don Sikora II, on the 1997-2001 Type SH): "3042-pound curb weight". The same 3,042 lb appears in The Auto Channel's 1999 Type SH panel ("3042 lbs.", heilig-1999-prelude-sh) and 1997 Type SH panel ("Curb Weight 3042 lbs.", russ-1997-prelude-sh): two independent editorial outlets with named authors agreeing. See discrepancies for Hagin's 2001 figure.

sources.title: Cheap Wheels: 1997-2001 Honda Prelude Type SH (Don Sikora II, Collectible Automobile, October 2019)
1997 Honda Prelude Type SH (review, Carey Russ)
2001 Honda Prelude Type SH (review, Tom Hagin)

discrepancies.reason: Tom Hagin's 2001 Type SH panel prints 'Curb Weight 3217 pounds', while the 1997 and 1999 Auto Channel panels and Collectible Automobile's 1997-2001 retrospective all print 3,042 lb.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 3,042 lb: three panels agree across the run, and the reference model year is 1999. Hagin's 3,217 lb is an outlier, possibly a misprint or a differently equipped car.

provisionalNote: Power (200 hp) rests on three agreeing named-author specification panels (The Auto Channel's 1999 and 2001 Type SH panels and Collectible Automobile), none of them a manufacturer page or a major-magazine panel as the power rule requires; no Honda page for the 5th-gen Prelude could be opened. Weight (3,042 lb) meets weight step 2 (two independent named-author outlets agreeing). A Honda press or brochure page, or a major-magazine specification panel, would make the record normal.
